title: Sherman family haunted off the ranch

tellings.quote: in the 90s a family named the shermans took over the ranch and were basically haunted off the property they encountered orbs ufos skin walkers and even got rushed by an oversized bipedal wolf that they claimed was able to withstand a close range attack from a shotgun

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in the 1990s a family called the Shermans took over Skinwalker Ranch in Utah, a property famous for strange happenings, and were basically haunted off it. According to his telling, they saw glowing orbs, UFOs and skinwalkers, shape-shifting creatures from Native American legend, and were even rushed by an oversized wolf walking on two legs that they said survived a close-range shotgun blast, which if true would make the ranch a hotspot for things science cannot explain.
